author: TheMightyTRexUK

added: **A logo** in Settings, Plug-ins, in the Catalogue and on its dashboard cards.
**Its cards say how things are:** a status and when they last changed, in the grey band at the top of each card.
**Updates safely:** before an update it finishes what it is doing and starts nothing new.
changed: Needs Starboard with plug-in API 1.14 or later. A Starboard with an older plug-in API keeps version 1.1.0.

added: **AudioVault search links:** for each film and series without audio description, a link to AudioVault's own search. Deactivated until you activate it in Sources; Starboard never downloads from AudioVault
**YouDescribe search links:** for each film and series, a link to YouDescribe's own search, where volunteers describe YouTube videos such as trailers
**MovieReading and Earcatch:** how to use these phone apps alongside Jellyfin, which play a description in step by listening, and where to get them
changed: **Audio description elsewhere:** each place is now a link that opens in a new tab

added: Finds the films and series in Jellyfin with a described sound track, once a night in quiet hours
Prefers releases with audio description in Reelix
People who want audio description: Jellyfin remembers the sound track each of them chooses
Audio description elsewhere, and two dashboard cards

description: Finds films and series in Jellyfin with a described sound track for blind and partially sighted people, and prefers releases with one in Reelix.

jobs.label: Look for titles with audio description
Keep the audio description choice in Reelix

name: Audio description

settings.hint: Adds an Audio description format to Reelix and prefers it in every quality level. Reelix still takes a release without it when there is no other.
settings.label: Prefer releases with audio description

settings.hint: A link to AudioVault's own search for each film and series without audio description. Starboard never downloads from AudioVault or reads its pages.
settings.label: AudioVault search links

settings.hint: A link to YouDescribe's own search for each film and series, for described trailers and clips on YouTube. Nothing is fetched from YouDescribe.
settings.label: YouDescribe search links

settings.hint: How to use these phone apps alongside Jellyfin, and where to get them. Neither publishes a list of titles, so Starboard cannot say which films they have.
